reasoning: The landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows an overhead electric (OHE) line running along the southern edge of the property. The vision analysis identified multiple proposed tree symbols positioned directly in the path of or very close to the OHE line in the southeastern section. According to UCM § 1.10.10.4, non-utility-compatible trees must be at least 15 lateral feet from distribution conductors and large trees (40+ ft mature height) must be at least 25 feet away. I need to measure the actual distances from the outside conductor to the proposed trees to determine if clearances are violated. These measurements will apply to checklist items EL-2.1 (non-utility-compatible trees within 15 ft), EL-2.3 (large trees within 25 ft), and EL-2.12/EL-2.13 (measurement methodology).
